messages.content: amar mone hoy ami nijer opinion ke suppress kori sobsomoy conflict avoid korার jonno
Eta khub costly habit hote pare long term e. Kobe theke eta notice korcho beshi?
recently, ekta decision e disagree korechilam kintu bolini kauke
What stopped you from speaking up in that specific moment?
mone hoyechilo amar opinion ta matter korবে na, tarা already decide kore fellechhilo

That assumption might be true sometimes, but it also becomes a self-fulfilling prophecy - if you never voice it, it definitely won't matter. Choto jaigay shuru koro, kom stakes e nijer opinion share korার practice koro, jate boro situation e voice ta stronger thake.
